description: This is a shell script for managing OCI containers, providing functions for starting, stopping, listing, inspecting, pausing, resuming, and executing commands within containers, as well as a command-line interface for user interaction.

methods.name: start_container_from_bundle
methods.description: Starts a container from an OCI bundle, extracting tarball if necessary, and sending a JSON-RPC request via curl.

methods.name: start_container_from_spec
methods.description: Starts a container from a Dobby specification JSON file, sending a JSON-RPC request via curl.

methods.name: stop_container
methods.description: Stops a running container by sending a JSON-RPC request.

methods.name: list_containers
methods.description: Lists all currently running containers by sending a JSON-RPC request.

methods.name: get_container_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific container.

methods.name: get_container_state
methods.description: Gets the current state of a container.

methods.name: execute_command
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container with optional parameters.

methods.name: ocicontainer_help
methods.description: Displays help information for available commands.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main loop that reads user input and dispatches container management commands.
